sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients WHERE borrowing_cap<=100000 AND client_identifier IN (SELECT client_identifier FROM remittances WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',remittance_moment)='2004')), t1.client_label FROM clients t1 JOIN remittances t2 ON t1.client_identifier=t2.client_identifier WHERE t1.borrowing_cap<=100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.remittance_moment)='2004' GROUP BY t1.client_identifier ORDER BY SUM(t2.total_value) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(t2.purchase_identifier) FROM merchandise t1 JOIN purchase_lines t2 ON t1.item_identifier=t2.item_identifier WHERE t1.suggested_retail-t1.acquisition_cost>100
SELECT SUM(t1.total_value) FROM remittances t1 JOIN clients t2 ON t1.client_identifier=t2.client_identifier WHERE t2.borrowing_cap=0 AND STRFTIME('%Y',t1.remittance_moment)='2003'

SELECT COUNT(t1.staff_identifier), t1.network_address FROM staff t1 JOIN branches t2 ON t1.branch_identifier=t2.branch_identifier WHERE t2.municipality='Sydney' AND t1.role_designation LIKE '%Sales Manager%'

SELECT t2.item_label, t1.requested_count*t1.unit_cost FROM purchase_lines t1 JOIN merchandise t2 ON t1.item_identifier=t2.item_identifier JOIN purchases t3 ON t1.purchase_identifier=t3.purchase_identifier JOIN clients t4 ON t3.client_identifier=t4.client_identifier JOIN staff t5 ON t4.commerce_agent_staff_identifier=t5.staff_identifier JOIN branches t6 ON t5.branch_identifier=t6.branch_identifier WHERE t6.municipality='Boston' AND t5.role_designation='Sales Rep' ORDER BY t1.requested_count*t1.unit_cost DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT dial_number FROM clients WHERE liaison_family_surname LIKE 'M%' AND nation<>'Germany'
SELECT SUM(total_value)/COUNT(client_identifier) FROM remittances WHERE remittance_moment>='2004-01-01' AND remittance_moment<'2004-07-01'

SELECT (t1.suggested_retail-t2.unit_cost)/t1.suggested_retail FROM merchandise t1 JOIN purchase_lines t2 ON t1.item_identifier=t2.item_identifier WHERE t2.item_identifier='S18_3482' AND t2.purchase_identifier=10108

SELECT CAST(COUNT(t1.client_identifier) AS REAL)/12 FROM purchases t1 JOIN purchase_lines t2 ON t1.purchase_identifier=t2.purchase_identifier JOIN merchandise t3 ON t2.item_identifier=t3.item_identifier WHERE t3.item_label='1957 Chevy Pickup'
